reason: I never buy from a page I haven't seen in a TikTok unboxing or heard about from a friend, and I've never heard of Baghdad Express. Paying on delivery for the first order helps, but I'd still wait until someone I follow shows their parcel arriving.
objection: If the clothes come in the wrong size or just look cheaper than in the photo, I can't return them because they don't take change-of-mind returns, and 21,000 IQD in fees for one pair of shoes is a lot from my salary.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or a TikTok creator I trust showing an unboxing from them where the item matched the photo and arrived on time.
